descriptor: Team profiles you can edit in place

voice.summary: Brightfield sounds like a helpful colleague in an internal tool: short, precise and quietly reassuring. Every edit is acknowledged in one line and every mistake can be undone.
dos: Confirm each save in a single short sentence
Tell people how to undo, and for how long
donts: Do not hide the undo behind a menu
Avoid exclamation marks on routine saves

taglines: Edit it right where it is
boilerplate: Brightfield is a people directory for growing teams, letting anyone update their profile in place with instant validation and a five-second undo for every change.

microcopy.success: Saved. You can undo for 5 seconds.
microcopy.error: That value is not valid. Check it and try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing added yet. Click to edit this field.

logo.note: A clean diamond reads as a polished profile card and a bright field of information.
